title: Cinderwing — Keeper of the Last Egg
description: A great crimson dragon crouches protectively over its golden egg, roaring beneath enormous flame-coloured, scalloped wings. Ivory horns, a plated gold throat, grasping claws and a curling grounded tail complete the creature.

sections.name: Four braced legs and ten ivory claws
Compact torso and rising serpentine neck
Flame membranes with load-bearing black finger bones
Armour along the back, shoulders and neck
Roaring face, split jaws and a crown of horns
Long hooked tail with an ivory sawtooth crest
The precious egg sheltered between the foreclaws
